profile.subject: a red shiba inu dog
profile.styleHints: red-tan coat with white chest and muzzle, erect ears, curled fluffy tail

cycle.prompt: horizontal sprite sheet of exactly 4 frames of the same red shiba inu dog trotting, strict side profile facing right, one eye visible, same size in every frame, 4 equal columns with wide magenta gaps, legs in walk sequence, curled fluffy tail, erect ears

profile.idlePrompt: Pose: standing alert in side view facing right, head up, erect ears, curled tail over back, four paws planted

rest.label: Sit
rest.prompt: Pose: sitting upright with front legs straight, curled fluffy tail around side, head facing right, calm

sleep.label: Nap time
sleep.prompt: Pose: curled up lying on side, paws tucked in, fluffy tail over nose, eyes closed sleeping

voice.label: Bark
voice.prompt: Pose: standing facing right, mouth open barking, ears perked, curled tail up, chest forward

trick.label: Beg!
trick.prompt: Pose: sitting up begging on hind legs, front paws lifted, head tilted right, curled tail wagging

lines: Look at my fluffy curled tail

facts.text: Shiba Inus come from Japan and are the smallest native Japanese dog.
Long ago in Japan, Shiba Inus hunted birds and small game in brush.
Shiba Inus have prick ears, curly tails, and soft fluffy coats.
